cd /tmp && SYNECDOCHE_SITE=/workspace/site LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native PYTHONPATH=/workspace/site timeout 175 python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, random, itertools, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from offline_discovery.rule_remove import exact_key_count
PADDING=1514
rng=random.Random(88)
def brute(kept, cap):
    keys=set()
    for cl in kept:
        L=cl['length']; iv=cl['range']
        opts=[[v for v in range(lo,hi+1) if v!=PADDING] for lo,hi in iv]
        total=1
        for o in opts: total*=len(o)
        if total==0: continue
        if total>200000: return None
        for combo in itertools.product(*opts): keys.add((L,combo))
        if len(keys)>200000: return None
    return min(len(keys), cap+1)
bad=0; tested=0; skipped=0; start=time.time()
for trial in range(2500):
    L=rng.randint(2,6); n=rng.randint(1,6)
    base=[rng.randint(0,8) for _ in range(L)]
    cls=[]
    for i in range(n):
        iv=[[max(0,base[j]-rng.randint(0,2)), min(3028,base[j]+rng.randint(0,3))] for j in range(L)]
        cls.append({'length':L,'range':iv})
    if rng.random()<0.3:
        L2=rng.randint(2,4)
        cls.append({'length':L2,'range':[[rng.randint(0,10),rng.randint(0,10)+2] for _ in range(L2)]})
    cap=rng.randint(0,300)
    exp=brute(cls,cap)
    if exp is None: skipped+=1; continue
    got=exact_key_count(cls,cap)
    tested+=1
    if got!=exp:
        bad+=1; print('MISMATCH', cls, cap, exp, got)
        if bad>3: break
print('tested',tested,'skipped',skipped,'bad',bad,'%.1fs'%(time.time()-start))
PYEOF
